content:
Talia Benson: Post-launch follow-up thread. We’re ~1 week in on Quickstart templates. Can folks drop: (1) top issues we’re seeing, (2) what we want in a patch release, (3) proposed ownership for ongoing maintenance.

Talia Benson: From Support + internal feedback so far (rough list):
- Confusion around 429 handling/backoff + “why does it retry forever?”
- Streaming disconnects behind proxies (nginx / corp proxies)
- RAG ingest/query timeouts with larger docs (default timeouts too low)
- Env var naming drift between Python/TS + docs snippets drift
- Docker Compose health checks flaky on slower laptops
- Telemetry: a few fields too high-cardinality (risk for Console dashboards)
- CORS gotchas on TS template when people run from a browser

Dev Patel: +1 on 429 confusion. We got 6 tickets in 48h that are basically: “I got rate limited and now it’s stuck / slow.” People want a copy-paste snippet explaining:
- respect `Retry-After`
- jitter
- cap total retry time
- surface a clear error after budget exhausted

Owen Phillips: Adding: a couple folks mis-set region/model and then blame the template because it “hangs” while the SDK retries. We should print a very explicit startup banner including `REDWOOD_BASE_URL`, `REDWOOD_REGION`, model, and whether streaming is on.

Monica Patel: On SDK side: TS helper already respects Retry-After but the template wraps it in a generic retry that can obscure the final error. Python helper (pr-512) has better “retry budget” semantics. We should align both templates on:
- `max_attempts`
- `max_elapsed_ms`
- log `retry_reason` + `retry_after_ms`

Monica Patel: Also: streaming disconnects behind proxies — we have a known issue where some proxies buffer SSE. We can:
- document recommended headers (`Cache-Control: no-cache`, `X-Accel-Buffering: no` for nginx)
- add a note: set proxy read timeout >= stream duration
- provide “fallback to non-streaming” option in config

Dana Lo: TS template: CORS is our fault-ish. We defaulted to allowing `http://localhost:3000` but folks run from random ports. We should either:
- default to `CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS=*` ONLY in dev mode (with a scary comment), or
- make it explicit in README and fail fast if origin isn’t allowed.

Naomi Feldman: Please don’t set `*` as a silent default. For safe defaults, dev-only is fine but it has to be behind `NODE_ENV=development` / `REDWOOD_ENV=dev` and the README must say “do not ship this.”

Sabrina James: Re: docs snippet drift — we can fix by generating snippets from repo in CI (Wei already has a script?) and have PR checks on docs. Right now I think INT-811 tracked some of this.

Wei Chen: Yep. Docs extraction is brittle when README headings change. I can tighten the markers and add “snippet contract” comments. But we should also reduce churn in README structure for patch.

Sahana Iyer: CI note: we had one flake in smoke tests due to Docker health check timing. We can relax health check retries and add a `STARTUP_GRACE_SECONDS` env var (or just bump defaults). Also: macOS + colima needs longer times for vector DB.

Sean Gallagher: SRE view: please do NOT “fix” timeouts by making everything 5 minutes. Better:
- set connect timeout low (e.g., 5s)
- set request timeout based on operation (chat vs ingest)
- separate LLM request timeout from vector DB / ingestion timeout
- put sane upper bound + surface a clear error code when we hit timeout

Rafael Mendes: +1. Also for alerts: we’re seeing a couple templates emitting `route=/chat?user_id=...` due to someone copying code and adding query params into route label. We need to keep the contract strict: `route` should be a stable template route name, not raw URL.

Logan Wright: Telemetry contract: the high-cardinality culprit seems to be `error_detail` and `tool_name` in span attributes. In Console, we want:
- `error_class` (small set)
- `error_code` (small set)
- `tool_name` should be allow-listed and normalized (don’t include user input)

Sergio Costa: For the “observability pack,” a few folks asked why dashboards don’t populate. It’s because they didn’t set `service.name` and `deployment.environment`. We should print those at startup + include a “verify telemetry” step:
- “open this endpoint”
- “you should see 1 trace within 30s”

Alex Martinez: Thanks. Let’s be concrete: propose patch release v1.0.1 to address top papercuts without adding new backends/features. Target end of week if possible.

Talia Benson: Draft patch scope (v1.0.1):
1) Retry/timeout alignment (Python + TS): retry budget, respect `Retry-After`, better terminal errors
2) Streaming behind proxies: README guidance + config toggle to disable streaming; add headers note
3) Env var contract cleanup: consistent names + fail-fast banner on startup
4) Docker compose health check: increase retries/grace; document macOS note
5) Telemetry tightening: remove/normalize high-cardinality attributes; add startup log showing service/env/request_id propagation
6) Docs fixes: 429 section + CORS section + snippet extraction stability

Connor O'Brien: Release/process: If we’re doing v1.0.1, we should tag and cut a changelog and update compatibility matrix with SDK versions. I can own the release checklist + tag + notes.

Elliot Price: Docs: I can take 429 + streaming proxy guidance pages, but I need the exact recommended wording from SDK/SRE to avoid over-promising. Also want a “common errors” table with:
- what you see
- likely cause
- fix

Monica Patel: I’ll provide SDK-canonical snippet for 429/backoff and streaming retry behavior (what we do, what we don’t do). We should explicitly say “do not retry non-idempotent tool actions” too.

Naomi Feldman: Security asks for patch:
- Ensure `.env` is in `.gitignore` across templates (some folks copy/paste and commit)
- Pre-commit secret scanning doc link + CI check mention
- Logging: add explicit note about PII redaction (don’t log prompts by default)

Dana Lo: On TS template, I can implement:
- startup banner
- strict CORS allow-list behavior
- unify env var names with Python
- add `STREAMING_ENABLED=false` config path

Sabrina James: I can do Python template changes (timeouts split per operation, better errors), plus README updates on ingest sizing.

Sean Gallagher: If you want my time, I’ll review the timeout/retry defaults and error taxonomy before merge. I’d like us to use consistent error codes: `RW_TIMEOUT`, `RW_RATE_LIMITED`, `RW_UPSTREAM_DISCONNECT`, etc.

Rafael Mendes: I can review the dashboard impact for telemetry field changes so we don’t break the pack.

Sergio Costa: I can update the observability pack README with a “getting data flowing” checklist and a screenshot note for service.name/env.

Talia Benson: Ownership proposal (post v1.0.x):
- Code owners: Dana (TS), Sabrina (Python)
- SDK liaison: Monica
- Docs owners: Elliot + Wei
- Release captain rotation monthly: Connor (first), then Sabrina, then Dana
- SRE/security reviewers for changes touching retries/telemetry/logging: Sean/Rafael + Naomi

Dev Patel: Can we add a lightweight “support triage rubric” doc? Like: what info to ask for (request_id, template version, SDK version, region/model, whether docker/k8s). Would cut our back-and-forth a lot.

Wei Chen: +1. We can add a `SUPPORT.md` in repo and link from README.

Buildkite: Build #1841 failed (redwood-quickstarts / smoke-tests): `vector-db` healthcheck timed out after 30s

Sahana Iyer: That’s the flake I mentioned. I’ll push a change to healthcheck retries + `start_period`. Should stabilize.

GitHub: opened PR redwood-quickstarts#417 "Patch v1.0.1: healthcheck grace + startup banner skeleton" (draft)

Alex Martinez: Love it. Let’s lock plan:
- By EOD tomorrow: PRs up for (retry/timeouts + streaming guidance + env var cleanup)
- Day after: docs updates
- End of week: v1.0.1 tag + release notes

Talia Benson: Action items (please reply with :thumbsup: when you’ve got an owner/ETA):
- Retry/timeout alignment: Monica + Sabrina + Dana
- Streaming proxy guidance: Elliot + Monica
- Env var contract + startup banner: Dana + Sabrina
- Healthcheck stability: Sahana
- Telemetry cardinality fixes: Logan + Rafael
- Observability pack README: Sergio
- Support triage doc (`SUPPORT.md`): Dev + Wei
- Release/tagging: Connor

Monica Patel: :thumbsup: I’ll drop the canonical 429/backoff snippet + “retry budget” guidance in PR comments today.

Dana Lo: :thumbsup: TS changes by tomorrow morning. Will keep CORS safe: dev-only relaxed mode behind `REDWOOD_ENV=dev`.

Sabrina James: :thumbsup: Python changes by tomorrow afternoon. I’ll add separate `INGEST_TIMEOUT_S` and `CHAT_TIMEOUT_S` (names tbd but consistent across languages).

Connor O'Brien: :thumbsup: I’ll prep v1.0.1 release notes template + changelog format. Please make sure PRs have “user-facing change” bullets.

Naomi Feldman: :thumbsup: I’ll review the logging + `.env` guidance once the PRs are ready.

Sean Gallagher: :thumbsup: Ping me on the retry/timeout defaults before merging.

Talia Benson: Great. I’ll schedule a 20-min patch readiness check Thursday. Keep updates in this thread.
